newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products prices hold steady, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products prices hold steady, trade thin.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady and quiet on Thursday, traders said.
Naphtha and gasoline held steady. Both barge and cargo prices talked in a slightly wider range with a shortage of fixed offers keeping the markets notional.
Gas oil firmed with futures but trade was minimal with much of Germany on holiday. Heating oil barges were priced at June IPE +$1.0/+$2.0 a tonne fon ARA for first half June delivery.
High sulphur fuel barges gained $1 on slightly better bunker demand but overall the bottom of the barrel was thinly discussed and numbers were broadly steady.
